_note: Authoritative TRAINABLE parameter counts for leaderboard rows whose run did not record params_M (the 3 bilateral/Wu solvers omitted the key — fixed 2026-06-19) OR whose config was pruned so it can't be recomputed live. Built by instantiating the real model on CPU and counting sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad); cross-checked against the verified per-family formulas. trainable == total for all these families (no frozen params). Keyed by run-dir slug; the value is the integer trainable-param count for the leaderboard's best iter. The Mayo board computes these live from cfg_full via the same formulas in gen_mayo_leaderboard.py; this file backstops the hand-curated breast/demo boards whose TPE configs are no longer on disk.

_formulas.bilateral (FullViewBilateralPipeline / D: trainable = 3 * (proj_n_bf + img_n_bf)   [3 params per BF: log_sx, log_sy, log_sr; default proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1 -> 6]
_formulas.wu_2015_trainable (TrainableWu2015): trainable = wu_n_bands + 2 + 2*wu_n_outer   [log_band_scale[nb] + sigmoid_slope + sigmoid_offset + log_soft_thresh[no] + residual_blend[no]]
